The '''Chem-Basin Mine''' was a mine on the poisonous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quesh]] that was important in the planet's supply of [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]]. Opened in [[3647 BBY]], the mine had been opened for four years by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chem-Basin Mine}}</ref> The mine was prone to frequent mishaps, with the very first survey team being nearly suffocated due to an accident with the exported Quesh venom.<ref name="Codex" />

==History==
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[3643 BBY]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces were drawing in on an assault at the mine. Fortunately for the miners trapped and captive inside, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Korvan]] tasked a traveling Republic hero for rescue, as well as to defeat the Imperial's inside. The hero succeeded, and the Empire was forced to abandon their operations at the mine.
